name: Inventory Sync for WooCommerce
author: Misha Rudrastyh

sections.description:
Inventory Sync for WooCommerce allows you to sync the stock of the products with the same SKUs between two WooCommerce stores (both for standalone store and for stores within the same WordPress Multisite network).

Features

✅ Sync Stock quantity, Stock Status, and Stock Management
Whether a Stock Management checkbox is checked or unchecked for a product, the plugin can still sync its stock status (or stock quantity if the checkbox is checked).

✅ Product variations are supported
The product variations must have the same SKU, but in the Pro version, you can connect them by attribute values.

✅ Instant sync
Instantly syncs stock changes when a product is purchased or edited via WordPress, or an order is refunded or cancelled.

✅ Two-directional product stock sync
The plugin allows you to connect two stores to each other and perform stock synchronisation both ways.

✅ WordPress Multisite support
Works with both regular WordPress sites and sub-sites within multisite networks.

Pro features

⚡️ Unlimited stores
There is no limit to how many stores you can connect to each other. You can also use complex connections like centralized stock synchronization.

⚡️ Exclude specific products
You can exclude specific products (or only variations within specific products) from the stock synchronization.

⚡️ Alternative product connection
Choose between SKU, “GTIN, UPC, EAN, or ISBN”, or Slug product connection type (can be helpful when not every product on your store has an SKU, or when they have duplicated SKUs).

⚡️ Asynchronous syncing
The plugin allows you to offload stock synchronization to Action Scheduler in WooCommerce, which gives a significant performance boost when an order with a lot of products is placed.

⚡️ Packed REST API requests
REST API requests are packed and sent in batches with the open-source PHP Requests library, which gives another performance boost in every scenario; here is the benchmark

⚡️ Bulk stock sync
A tool that allows you to push all product stock quantities to a selected store at once, available in WooCommerce > Status > Tools.

⚡️ WP-CLI commands
The Pro version of the plugin allows you to manage stock synchronization via WP-CLI.

⚡️ Product type transition when syncing
You can sync variations to simple products and vice versa.

🚀 Upgrade to Pro

Did you know?

The plugins for syncing products specifically, Product Sync for WooCommerce, or its Pro version, Simple WP Crossposting, also allow you to sync product stock, but only when updating products. So, these plugins don’t cover the situation when an order is placed.

Need Help?

If you are faced with any type of issue while using the media folders plugin or if you have an improvement suggestion, please visit the support forum, and I will help you ASAP.
sections.installation:
Automatic Install

  1. Log into your WordPress dashboard and go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Inventory Sync for WooCommerce”
  3. Click “Install Now” under the “Inventory Sync for WooCommerce” plugin
  4. Click “Activate Now”

Manual Install

  1. Download the plugin from the download button on this page
  2. Unzip the file, and upload the resulting inventory-sync-for-woocommerce folder to your /wp-content/plugins directory
  3. Log into your WordPress dashboard and go to Plugins
  4. Click “Activate” under the “Inventory Sync for WooCommerce Lite” plugin
sections.faq:
Does it work on localhost?

Yes, it does.

The inventory sync is going to work great between localhost websites or from the localhost to a remote site. In that case, you would either need to use application passwords instead of WooCommerce REST API credentials or simply move to the Pro version of the plugin. Do not forget though that in order to create an application password on the localhost you need to set WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE to local in your wp-config.php file.

Does it support two-directional inventory sync?

Yes, it does.

But in this case you need to install the plugin on both sites and add each one in the plugin settings.

Can this plugin sync other product information?

This lite version of the plugin can only sync Stock quantity, Stock Status and Stock Management checkbox. In the Pro version of the plugin you can also include some other basic product information like prices with a hook (you can find it in the documentation).

However, if you’d like to sync all WooCommerce product information (product images, variations, and so on), take a look at my other plugins which are developed specifically for that purpose.

Multisite Product Sync – for WooCommerce multisite installations.

Product Sync – for standalone WooCommerce stores.

What if I only need to sync product prices without all the product information and installing additional plugins?

It is also possible to achieve with the filter hooks rudr_invsync_product_data (and rudr_wpmu_invsync_product_data).

Though, these hooks are only available in the Pro version of the plugin.
